function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"WITH sl_agg AS (
 SELECT period, SUM(qty) AS total_qty, SUM(revenue_cad) AS total_rev
 FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.sales_line
 WHERE period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
 GROUP BY period
),
gl_agg AS (
 SELECT period,
        SUM(CASE WHEN account_type = 'revenue' THEN amount_cad ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_cad,
        SUM(CASE WHEN account_type IN ('cogs','5000 goods','5100 packaging') THEN amount_cad ELSE 0 END) AS cogs_cad
 FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.gl_balance
 WHERE period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
 GROUP BY period
)
SELECT s.period,
       s.total_qty,
       s.total_rev,
       g.revenue_cad AS gl_revenue,
       g.cogs_cad,
       (g.revenue_cad - g.cogs_cad) AS gross_margin,
       s.total_rev / s.total_qty AS avg_selling_price,
       (g.revenue_cad - g.cogs_cad) / s.total_qty AS margin_per_unit,
       (s.total_rev / s.total_qty) - ((g.revenue_cad - g.cogs_cad) / s.total_qty) AS implied_cost_per_unit
FROM sl_agg s
JOIN gl_agg g ON s.period = g.period
ORDER BY s.period","purpose":"Compute implied cost per unit to see if cost changed"}
